title: Made entity, selector, comparison, and document-QC boundaries explicit
points: Router traces now persist typed entity-resolution context so topic acronyms such as SPM do not displace valid company scope or create false unresolved-ticker incidents.
Peer selectors now pass their evidence-backed selected tickers to dependent valuation and filing lanes without being discarded by broad-universe metadata.
Dependent filing lanes now disclose partial peer coverage instead of failing and discarding valid pages when some selected companies have no matching commentary.
Shared comparison tables provide deterministic minimum, maximum, availability, and period-basis facts to the Analyst, with one model-authored retry when conclusions contradict those facts.
Latest bank deposits retain their point-in-time basis and are no longer described as annual solely because of their period-end date.

The CNERGY 2025 fixed-asset page was reparsed from the source PDF, correcting a shifted safety-and-lab-equipment written-down value, and the refreshed 989-page CNERGY corpus was published to D1 behind a deterministic negative-WDV quarantine check.
